title: Pip Gets a Hit
skill_description: A little dog named Pip chases a red ball through the park and finally catches it after several tries.
author: FunBookies

pip.name: Pip

story_bible.premise: A little dog named Pip chases a red ball through the park and finally catches it after several tries.

pages.text: Pip is my dog. Pip can run and sit. I see Pip in the park.
pages.scene: Wide shot: Small brown and white spotted dog with floppy ears sitting on bright green grass in sunny park with trees in background. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Pip can see a red ball. The big red ball is fun!
pages.scene: Medium shot: Brown and white dog looking excitedly at bright red ball sitting on green grass near park bench. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Pip ran to get the ball. Run, run, run!
pages.scene: Medium shot: Small spotted dog running across green park grass with ears flapping, red ball visible ahead on the ground. Motion lines show movement. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Pip ran to hit the ball. But Pip ran past it!
pages.scene: Close-up shot: Brown and white dog running past red ball on grass, looking surprised as the ball remains behind. Park trees in soft background. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: The red ball sat on the grass. Pip was sad.
pages.scene: Medium shot: Small dog sitting with drooping ears and sad expression looking at red ball a few feet away on green grass. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Pip ran back to the ball. Can Pip get it?
pages.scene: Medium shot: Determined brown and white dog running back toward bright red ball on park grass, ears perked up with hopeful expression. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Pip ran fast. Pip can hit the ball!
pages.scene: Action shot: Spotted dog running very fast toward red ball with focused expression, grass and motion lines showing speed. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Hit! Pip hit the red ball. The ball ran away.
pages.scene: Dynamic shot: Brown and white dog making contact with red ball, ball bouncing away across green park grass with motion lines. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Run, Pip, run! Get the big red ball!
pages.scene: Wide shot: Small dog chasing bouncing red ball across sunny park with trees and path in background, both dog and ball in motion. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Pip ran and ran. Pip can get it!
pages.scene: Medium shot: Determined spotted dog gaining on red ball as it slows down on park grass, dog's tongue hanging out happily. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Yes! Pip got the red ball. Pip bit the ball.
pages.scene: Close-up shot: Happy brown and white dog holding red ball gently in mouth with proud, joyful expression and wagging tail visible. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.

pages.text: Pip had fun in the park. My dog got the ball!
pages.scene: Medium shot: Content spotted dog sitting on green grass holding red ball, tail wagging, with sunny park setting and trees creating peaceful background. Bright watercolor with soft edges and cheerful colors. NO TEXT anywhere in image.
